data-cleaning.name: Data cleaning
data-cleaning.description: Correct missing values, duplicates, inconsistent types, and invalid observations.

exploratory-analysis.name: Exploratory data analysis
exploratory-analysis.description: Investigate distributions, relationships, outliers, and data limitations before drawing conclusions.

descriptive-statistics.name: Descriptive statistics
descriptive-statistics.description: Summarize distributions, central tendency, dispersion, and grouped comparisons.

hypothesis-testing.name: Hypothesis testing
hypothesis-testing.description: Evaluate statistical hypotheses using suitable tests, uncertainty estimates, and stated assumptions.

experiment-design.name: Experiment design
experiment-design.description: Plan controlled comparisons with sampling, assignment, power, and measurement safeguards.

data-visualization.name: Data visualization
data-visualization.description: Build charts that communicate comparisons, trends, distributions, and uncertainty.

dashboard-design.name: Dashboard design
dashboard-design.description: Build analytical views with clear metrics, useful filters, and consistent definitions.

metric-modeling.name: Business metric modeling
metric-modeling.description: Define measures with explicit populations, aggregation rules, and calculation logic.

cohort-analysis.name: Cohort analysis
cohort-analysis.description: Compare customer or user groups over time to evaluate behavior and retention.

funnel-analysis.name: Funnel analysis
funnel-analysis.description: Measure progression through defined events and identify conversion drop-offs.

time-series-analysis.name: Time series analysis
time-series-analysis.description: Analyze trends, seasonality, dependencies, and forecast uncertainty in time-ordered observations.

causal-inference.name: Causal inference
causal-inference.description: Estimate effects using explicit causal assumptions, appropriate comparisons, and sensitivity checks.

statistical-modeling.name: Statistical modeling
statistical-modeling.description: Fit statistical models while checking assumptions, uncertainty, and interpretation.
